integrity_note: Proof gives full all-n statements; bundled finite numerical checks are supplementary and do not constitute independent validation. The two Lloyd maps use different distance-based centroids.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed n>=3, analytic branch existence and reflection-subspace attraction hold only for sufficiently small concentration; regular-n-gon nonfixed theorem holds for every positive concentration. No full-space stability, global convergence or global optimality is claimed.
title: Distinct analytic pinning responses of intrinsic and chordal circular Lloyd dynamics
